title: 第九章 迈巴赫和人形法拉利第十章 不吃牛肉症患者
content_zh:
难道是...麻雀也进化了？
还是说...自己的实力提升了，都能听懂麻雀说话了？
“不对...”
麻雀不可能进化，因为墙底下也有其他人路过，如果麻雀会说话，别人肯定也会听到。
自己的实力提升只是增强肉身强度，绝不至于变异。
是精神沟通！
脑力lv.2的其中一个天赋。
“没想到精神沟通是这样用的，它让我可以听懂动物讲话。”
这能力简直太强了。
这些动物每天游走于城市和郊区，能给自己带来许多别人不知道的信息，可以帮助自己更好地避开麻烦。
他在这个世界上的存活几率又大大提高了不少。
同时，也让他明白一个问题。
那就是他为什么会这么饥饿。
一开始他就很好奇，如果是智力增加，应该不至于这么饿，因为爱因斯坦、牛顿那些科学家也没有传出饥饿或者晕倒的历史，学校的教授也没说特别能吃，而他却很渴求能量。
现在看来，脑力不仅仅包含智力，还有精神力，或许以后还存在其他能力，所以才需要消耗能量。
刚想明白这个问题，林夜口袋里的手机忽然间震动起来。
他掏出手机，屏幕上的来电显示是张郃。
林夜接通电话。
“喂。”
“老林，你在哪儿呢？”

“我在校外，怎么了？”
“辅导员刚刚在班级群里发消息，召集全班回去呢。”
“怎么突然召集全班回去？”
林夜面露不解，现在是大四最后一学期，大家都忙着找工作的事情，大多数人都不在班里，有些人甚至不在魔都，班里居然突然临时召回？
“我也不知道，你在哪儿？我去找你，给你看样好东西，到时候咱俩一块回去。”
“我在浦江希尔顿附近。”
“ok！等我，一会儿就到。”
挂了电话，林夜看了一眼信息群，发现辅导员果然在喊人，而且还很急，有同学问原因，她也不说，只是一味催促众人回来，不过在外地的暂时可以不用回来。
约莫十来分钟，一辆帅得掉渣的双拼色迈巴赫s680停在路边。
这辆车子几乎可以说是绝大多数男人的梦中情车了。
数百万的落地价，v12的发动机...是无数人难以企及的梦。
出生的时候有就有，没有这辈子几乎也就没有了。
林夜曾经也对这辆车暗生情愫，但此刻再看，竟也觉得不过如此。
“实力和金钱，果然会改变一个人的思想和眼界。”
林夜摇了摇头，手机里的号码却是再度响起，依旧是张郃打来的。
“喂，你到了没？”
“我到了啊，你在哪儿呢？我怎么都没有看到你？”
听到张郃的话，林夜的脸色忽然间变得有些怪异起来。
他看了看不远处的迈巴赫，脑海里闪过张郃的一句话——等着哥开大奔带你装逼...
“那辆骚包的迈巴赫s680，不会就是你的车吧？”

“你还真在这儿呢？”
张郃的身影已经从迈巴赫上走下来，他穿着一身紫色衬衫，梳着油亮的头型，整个人像极了酒吧里的油腻小生，还在四处观望。
“这边。”
林夜颇为无语地挥了挥手，张郃看到林夜，瞬间瞪得眼睛老大。
content_en:
Could it be that... sparrows have also evolved?
Or... my strength has improved and I can understand sparrows?
"That's not right..."
It is impossible for sparrows to evolve, because there are other people passing by under the wall. If sparrows can talk, others will definitely hear them.
The improvement of his own strength only increases the strength of his physical body, and will never mutate.
It’s spiritual communication!
One of the talents of Brainpower lv.2.
"I didn't expect spiritual communication to be used in this way. It allows me to understand animals' speech."
This ability is simply too strong.
These animals roam around cities and suburbs every day and can bring them a lot of information that others don't know, which can help them better avoid trouble.
His chances of survival in this world have been greatly improved.
At the same time, it also made him understand a problem.
That's why he's so hungry.
He was very curious from the beginning. If his intelligence increased, he would not be so hungry, because scientists such as Einstein and Newton had no history of hunger or fainting, and the professors at the school did not say that they were particularly good at eating, but he was very thirsty for energy.
It seems now that brain power not only includes intelligence, but also mental power. Perhaps there will be other abilities in the future, so energy needs to be consumed.
Just when he figured this out, Lin Ye's cell phone suddenly vibrated in his pocket.
He took out his mobile phone and the caller ID on the screen was Zhang He.
Lin Ye answered the phone.
"Hello."
"Old Lin, where are you?"
"I'm outside school, what's wrong?"
"The counselor just sent a message in the class group to call the whole class back."
"Why did you suddenly call the whole class back?"
Lin Ye looked puzzled. It was the last semester of senior year and everyone was busy looking for jobs. Most of them were not in the class. Some people were not even in the city. The class was suddenly recalled temporarily?
"I don't know either. Where are you? I'll go find you and show you something good. Then we'll go back together."
"I'm near the Pujiang Hilton."
"Okay! Wait for me, I'll be there in a minute."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Ye took a look at the message group and found that the counselor was indeed calling people, and she was in a hurry. Some students asked why, but she didn't tell them. She just urged them to come back, but those who were out of town didn't need to come back for the time being.
About ten minutes later, a ridiculously handsome Maybach S680 with dual colors parked on the side of the road.
This car can almost be said to be the dream car of most men.
With a landing price of several million, the V12 engine... is a dream that is unattainable for countless people.
It is there when you are born, and if it were not there, it would almost be gone in this life.
Lin Ye once had a secret affection for this car, but looking at it now, he felt that it was nothing more than that.
"Strength and money will indeed change a person's thinking and vision."
Lin Ye shook his head, but the number on his phone rang again, and it was still Zhang He.
"Hey, are you here?"
"I'm here, where are you? Why didn't I see you?"
Hearing Zhang He's words, Lin Ye's expression suddenly became a little strange.
He looked at the Maybach not far away, and Zhang He's words flashed through his mind - Wait until I drive you to the big Ben to show off...
"That naughty Maybach s680, isn't it your car?"
"Are you really here?"
Zhang He's figure had already stepped off the Maybach. He was wearing a purple shirt and his shiny hair. He looked like a greasy boy in a bar, and he was still looking around.
"This way."
Lin Ye waved his hand speechlessly. Zhang He's eyes widened when he saw Lin Ye.
